stories.title: Malgré un rapport accablant, le parlement poursuit l’acquisition des F-35 en ajoutant 400 millions

en.title: Despite damning report, parliament proceeds with F-35 acquisition by adding 400 million
en.summary: Switzerland's National Council approved an additional 400 million francs for F-35 fighter jet acquisition one week after a critical management report. The right-wing majority supported the decision despite left-wing opposition.

stories.title: Rolex renforce sa présence sur la montre classique et donne une nouvelle leçon d’ouverture

en.title: Rolex strengthens its presence in classic watches and gives a new lesson in openness
en.summary: Rolex expanded its traditional watchmaking collection by introducing a new model within its Perpetual line, featuring a calendar mechanism previously known informally as the "padellone" by Italian collectors.

stories.title: Le Conseil des Etats demande davantage de transparence dans Tardoc

en.title: Council of States demands greater transparency in Tardoc
en.summary: Switzerland's Council of States approved a motion requesting regular monitoring of costs in the new Tardoc medical tariff system, which was introduced at the start of the year.

stories.title: Depuis le retour de Donald Trump, plus de 2800 postes ont été supprimés dans les organisations internationales à Genève

en.title: Since Donald Trump's return, over 2,800 positions have been eliminated in international organizations in Geneva
en.summary: International organizations in Geneva have lost more than 2,800 positions since Donald Trump's return to the U.S. presidency, attributed to reduced funding from the United States and other countries.

stories.title: En 2025, un quart des bâtiments suisses possédait une pompe à chaleur

en.title: In 2025, a quarter of Swiss buildings had a heat pump
en.summary: By late 2025, 25% of Swiss buildings were equipped with heat pumps. Heating oil remains the primary energy source for heating but its share is declining.

stories.title: La loutre est de retour à Genève, observée cet été dans l'Arve

en.title: The otter returns to Geneva, observed this summer in the Arve
en.summary: An otter was spotted in Geneva during the summer, marking a return of the species to the region after a long absence.

stories.title: Catherine Ringer, célèbre voix des Rita Mitsouko, est décédée à l’âge de 68 ans

en.title: Catherine Ringer, famous voice of Rita Mitsouko, died at age 68
en.summary: Catherine Ringer, iconic singer of the French rock duo Rita Mitsouko, passed away on the night of September 14, 2026, following cancer.

stories.title: Catherine Ringer, célèbre voix du groupe rock Rita Mitsouko, est décédée

en.title: Catherine Ringer, famous voice of rock group Rita Mitsouko, died
en.summary: Catherine Ringer, a major figure in French rock and half of Rita Mitsouko, died on the night of September 14, 2026, from a sudden cancer.

stories.title: VIDEO - Die Serie «Widow’s Bay» ist Überraschungssiegerin der Emmy Awards

en.title: VIDEO - The series "Widow's Bay" is the surprise winner of the Emmy Awards
en.summary: Apple TV's comedy series won 14 Emmy Awards at the ceremony, setting a record in the comedy category.

stories.title: Les pompes à chaleur supplantent progressivement le mazout dans les bâtiments suisses

en.title: Heat pumps are gradually replacing heating oil in Swiss buildings
en.summary: By the end of 2025, a quarter of Switzerland's residential buildings were equipped with heat pumps, according to federal statistics, though heating oil remained the primary energy source for 33 percent of homes.

stories.title: Plus de 2800 emplois supprimés à Genève depuis le retour de Donald Trump à la présidence

en.title: More than 2800 jobs eliminated in Geneva since Donald Trump's return to the presidency
en.summary: International organizations in Geneva have cut over 2800 positions since Donald Trump returned to the U.S. presidency, though Swiss federal authorities consider the figure less severe than initially feared.

stories.title: 'Widow's Bay' et 'The Pitt' dominent les Emmy Awards

en.title: 'Widow's Bay' and 'The Pitt' dominate the Emmy Awards
en.summary: The horror comedy 'Widow's Bay' won 14 trophies at the Emmy Awards ceremony, the equivalent of the Oscars for American television, while the medical series 'The Pitt' also achieved significant success.

stories.title: Einheitliche Berufe in Europa: Die EU will dies endlich ermöglichen, Verbände melden Protest an

en.title: Unified professions in Europe: The EU finally wants to enable this, associations protest
en.summary: The EU aims to standardize professions across Europe to make it easier for EU citizens and Swiss residents to accept jobs abroad and deepen the internal market.

stories.title: Der Ölschock trifft die Schweiz weniger als andere Länder. Doch wieso wird Diesel deutlich teurer als Benzin?

en.title: Oil shock hits Switzerland less than other countries. But why is diesel becoming significantly more expensive than petrol?
en.summary: Switzerland experiences less impact from rising energy prices compared to other nations. However, diesel prices are rising faster than petrol prices due to greater scarcity in the diesel market.

stories.title: KURZMELDUNGEN - Wirtschaft: Verwaltungsrat von Migros Online stellt sich neu auf

en.title: BRIEF UPDATES - Economy: Board of Migros Online restructures
en.summary: The Migros Online board is undergoing reorganization.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - «Die Marktschreier rufen die globale Krise aus – und dann passiert nichts», sagt der Präsident des Private-Equity-Riesen Blackstone

en.title: INTERVIEW - "Market criers announce global crisis – and then nothing happens," says Blackstone private equity giant's president
en.summary: Jonathan Gray, president of Blackstone, one of the largest AI boom investors, dismisses bubble concerns as unfounded and addresses growing anxiety among private investors.

stories.title: Die Schweiz gerät wegen der OECD-Mindeststeuer ins Hintertreffen. Zwei Professoren wollen Abhilfe schaffen

en.title: Switzerland falls behind due to OECD minimum tax. Two professors want to provide a remedy
en.summary: Switzerland has become less tax-attractive for large corporations, particularly since the USA withdrew from the OECD minimum tax agreement. A new expert report suggests potential countermeasures to address this disadvantage.
